text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's a Mejiro! A Mejiro! Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She flew through the pack like a stream
of shining
light accelerating through the
final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Urgh... I tried to throw her off a bunch of times, but she didn't waver for a second.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What a brave and bold stride... How
unflappable
can someone be?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think that one's pride in their house
could
motivate them so much...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You did it, Bright! Congrats! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wow. Just wow, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's right, everyone. Take a good
look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This is the light of the new Mejiros!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright has won the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiros' pride, their undying
glory—the age
of this esteemed clan is
not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is won by the successor
of a
notable family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The drama of the victory shakes all of
Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Grandmother! It's Bright, she—

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she is a Mejiro. She loves the
Mejiros, and
she takes pride in her
heritage.

text_block_list.name: Grandmother Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
As long as an Umamusume like her races,
the light
of the Mejiro family will never
fade.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I believe Bright has now
forged a new
path.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. Did you see? I won.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I once was just a burden but... I think
now I've
become the hope of the Mejiro
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I thought that it might happen someday,
but it
took so much time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I hope, one day, people
can
understand that about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I hope they'll come to believe in me,
despite my
dawdling nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how slowly she ran, Mejiro
Bright
always had her eyes on the
summit, even from the
rear of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't the only one who understood
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh dearie... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I return Mejiro Bright's watery smile with
a
confident one of my own, quietly
guiding her to
the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winners have a duty to forge the path
ahead; to
light the way, so that others
may follow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you all. I am Bright from
the Mejiro
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today has been an incredible day. I'm so
pleased
that I was able to compete
against so many
incredible Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I hope you don't mind, but there's
something in
particular I would like to
talk about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell you how I came to stand in
this
circle, this very special place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I walked a path unique to the Mejiros,
one paved
by generations of admiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro Umamusume before me have

accomplished incredible feats. However,
to me,
those are not mere stories of
eminent persons.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They are dazzling stories of freedom,
because
each of those Umamusume had
their own unique
charm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They held glory in one hand, hardship in
the
other. Yet the Mejiro family did not
yield. We
persevered in the face of
changing times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Though the Mejiro family has changed,
we have
always protected what is most
important to us,
even today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The reason we have managed to thrive
for so long
is because we walk the path
that is right for us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today, I wanted to show that the
Mejiros will
continue down that path,
but we will also
continue to change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I hope... I hope my victory today has
proven that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's exactly as she says. The Mejiros have

changed, but they have also protected
what has
made them so revered.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. The Mejiro family has been
around since
long before we were born.
One could say their
history is instead
legend.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
They are a family that reliably proves
itself
worthy of admiration. I see no signs
that their
light would be extinguished by
changing tides.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Words of praise rise to the lips of the
nearby
Umamusume while their eyes
gleam with
admiration. The light of this
well-known family
has not grown
dimmer, nor will it anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've always watched everyone else shine
so
brightly from the rear of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's how I know the different ways you
all shine.
I can see your light, even now
that I stand at the
front.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I invite all Umamusume to join us
Mejiros...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...On our path to a bright future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this victory, the Mejiro family
avoids being
swept under the wave of a
new generation and is
restored to
dazzling brilliance alongside Mejiro

Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It might sound like a miracle, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In reality, the stories of many
Umamusume,
waiting for their turn in the
adoring sunlight, have
long glimmered at
the base of Mount Yotei.
